name: treg
description: Access 3,800+ data APIs and tools - people enrichment, AEO, SEO, ads, social, UGC video and images - pay per call, no subscription.

interface.longDescription:
Access 3,800+ data APIs and tools from one place - people and company enrichment, AEO and SEO, ad libraries, social and trends, web scraping, UGC video, image generation and voice. No subscriptions, no provider sign-ups, no API keys: pay per call from one prepaid balance.

Ask in plain words ("find this person's work email", "backlinks for this domain", "make a 5-second UGC video") and treg shows every provider that can do it, with price, success rate and speed, so your agent picks the best one and tells you the cost first.

Already have a provider key or a Google Analytics / Search Console connection? treg uses it, and those calls are free.
defaultPrompt: Find the work email for a person at a company using treg.
Use treg to get the backlink profile for a domain, and tell me what it costs first.
Search treg's catalog for a way to get keyword search volume and compare the options on price.
